Xiamen Jihong Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and
listed in 2016 (stock name: JIHONG GROUP; code: 002803).
Headquartered in Xiamen, China, with registered capital of RMB                                                   JIHON
378,409,288, it specializes in display packaging for fast-moving                                        G                                                                                   JIHONG
consumer goods and serves leading companies in the sector. It
produces paper carrier bags, food packaging and other paper
products. Services cover packaging design, solution and process
optimization, prepress platemaking, printing and production, and
supply chain optimization.
ANHUI JIHONG EP PAPER PRODUCTS
Annual output is 9.3 billion paper bags and food packaging
products. The company has 10 production sites across China
and long-term strategic partnerships with McDonald's, McCafé,
KFC, Pizza Hut, Burger King, SUBWAY, Wallace, Dicos,
Woolworths, Amazon, Starbucks, Luckin Coffee, Costa Coffee,
Yili, Coca-Cola, Tastien, ERKE, Xtep and other domestic and
international brands. Products include shopping and food bags,
cartons, cups, bowls, buckets, burger and fries boxes, burger
wrappers, placemats and pizza boxes. Its high-quality products
are trusted by major brands, with sales worldwide.
As a high-tech enterprise in Xiamen, the company has
experienced printing and bag-making staff, over 1,000 advanced
production machines and more than 50 R&D specialists. It
invests in innovation, precision laboratories and modern
inspection equipment, inspecting raw materials, work in progress                JIHONG
and finished products to ensure high standards. Its B2B services
provide integrated marketing, design and packaging for leading
consumer-goods companies. It has also become a leading
cross-border social e-commerce company in Southeast Asia and
ranked fifth among China's Top 100 Printing and Packaging
Enterprises in 2022.
